title: Bakery and Postcard
author: Noor Ravensworth
blurb: Hazel Villalobos, a marine biologist counting turtles instead of heartbreaks, believes second chances are for people with better timing. Then a fake date to survive a family reunion feels too real by dessert — and they are pulled straight into the middle of it. Now they must let someone stay after the last train leaves, and time is already running out.
style: warm, character-driven storytelling with gentle humor
